text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text:
While you have a Tamer, you may ignore this card's color requirements.
[Security] Give 1 of your opponent's Digimon ＜Security A. -1＞ for the turn.
[Main] Place this card as 1 of your non-white Digimon's bottom digivolution card.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [All Turns] When this Digimon would be deleted in battle, by placing 1 [Recharge Plug-In Q] from its digivolution cards as the bottom security card, it isn't deleted.
